statements.t: “We expect FDA feedback in the fourth quarter of 2026 to inform the use of this formulation in our RECOVER-2 registrational Phase 3 trial and a future New Drug Application (NDA) submission for the treatment of schizophrenia.
Following that feedback, we plan to initiate a bioequivalence study to confirm comparability of the new formulation in the first quarter of 2027.
We also target initiation of RECOVER-2 patient enrollment in the first half of 2027, subject to receipt of additional financing.
